## 前置讲义摘要（你必须基于这些已建立的认知继续，不要重复，要承接）

### u1-l1 OLMo-core 是什么：项目定位与全景图

本讲确立 OLMo-core 的定位：它是 AI2 维护的 OLMo 系列模型训练库（PyPI 名 ai2-olmo-core），提供建模与训练的可组合「积木」组件；模型权重发布在 Hugging Face Hub，二者是「工厂与产品」关系，HF/vLLM 与评测工具属消费侧。讲义分三个模块：生态位、四类能力、仓库结构与可选依赖。四类能力指可组合组件库（src/olmo_core）、官方训练脚本（--dry-run 可零成本查看完整配置，支持点号路径命令行覆盖）、Docker/Beaker 镜像与启动器、推理与生态集成（chat、HF 互转）。仓库分四大区域：库源码、测试、脚本、示例；核心仅依赖 PyTorch，flash-attn、grouped_gemm、torchao 等可选依赖经 try/except ImportError 按需挂载。核心结论是「核心轻量、功能按需安装」；点号路径覆盖预示贯穿全库的「一切皆 Config」设计（第 2 单元主题），训练 190M 模型所需组件的猜想留待第 4 讲验证。
### u1-l2 环境搭建：安装、测试与代码检查

本讲围绕 OLMo-core 的环境搭建：安装、测试与代码检查。核心结论：PyPI 包名为 ai2-olmo-core，开发安装应先装匹配硬件的 PyTorch，再做可编辑安装 `pip install -e '.[all]'`；核心依赖仅 13 个包，flash-attn 等重功能拆入 extras 可选依赖组，all 为并集。关键概念：pyproject.toml 是依赖与 black/isort/ruff/mypy/pytest 工具配置的唯一事实来源；测试目录 src/test/ 镜像源码结构；GPU 测试采用「@pytest.mark.gpu 标记（仅供 CI 用 -m 筛选）+ 函数体内 CUDA 不可用即 pytest.skip() + importorskip 应对可选扩展缺失」的多层机制实现无 GPU 自动跳过，标记本身不产生跳过。贡献节奏为先 make style 自动格式化、再 make checks 三连检。官方 Docker 镜像只冻结难编译的 CUDA 依赖而不含源码，源码由 launch 流程现场克隆安装。config_test.py 中的 dotlist 覆盖断言预告了下一单元的 Config 主题。
### u1-l3 源码地图：目录结构与测试布局

本讲绘制 OLMo-core 的源码心智地图。src/ 下五大区域各司其职：olmo_core/ 是库本体，test/ 为镜像其结构的单元测试，scripts/ 是官方训练脚本，examples/ 是教学示例，integration_tests/ 做端到端集成测试。库根 __init__.py 极轻、仅做环境准备，全库「按子包导入」，各子包 __init__.py 即门面（docstring、再导出、__all__、门面函数），训练遵循「准备环境→组装组件→fit()→清理」的生命周期骨架。定位口诀：模型→nn/、数据→data/、训练→train/、分布式→distributed/、优化→optim/；几乎每个子包都有自己的 config.py，体现「一切皆 Config」。测试按「目录镜像 + foo.py 改名 foo_test.py」组织，GPU 测试靠标记与 importorskip、pytest.skip 三层机制跳过。TransformerConfig、TrainerConfig、NumpyDatasetConfig 三大谱系均汇聚于 Config 基类；muP、CompletedP 等跨子包功能成对分布于模型侧与优化侧。
### u1-l4 跑通第一个训练例子：examples/llm/train.py

本讲精读自包含示例 train.py，确立「一次训练实验 = 一份 ExperimentConfig」：由 model、dataset、data_loader、train_module、trainer 五块 Config 积木组成，各组件经 build() 按依赖顺序装配——模型（meta 设备占位）→训练模块（含优化器与 FSDP）→数据集→数据加载器（需数据并行进程组）→训练器。训练由 torchrun 拉起，prepare/teardown_training_environment 统一完成分布式初始化与收尾。Trainer.fit() 只做编排：恢复 checkpoint、pre_train 钩子、mock batch 预热后循环单步（train_batch 前向反向、optim_step 更新、zero_grads 清梯度，回调钩子穿插其间），计算全部委托 train_module。关键术语：rank、FSDP、以 token 计的 global_batch_size 与 rank_microbatch_size、梯度累积、--dry-run 零数据预览与 dotlist 覆盖。
### u2-l1 Config 基类：一切配置的基石

本讲解析 `Config` 基类（src/olmo_core/config.py），它是全库「一切皆 Config」的地基，分三个最小模块：基类本身、yaml/json 序列化、dotlist 覆盖（merge）。核心结论：子类须重新加 `@dataclass`、字段只用简单类型或嵌套 Config，即免费获得序列化、嵌套组合与 dotlist 覆盖能力；基类没有 `save()`，存档需自行将 `as_config_dict()` 结果写盘。序列化出口两种：`as_dict()` 无损供程序内用，`as_config_dict()` 注入 `_CLASS_` 与 `type`、JSON 安全，是官方存档格式；入口 `from_dict`/`from_yaml`/`from_json` 依 `_CLASS_` 动态 import 还原确切子类，保证往返（round-trip）等价。`merge(dotlist)` 走「转 dict → 下钻改值 → 重建」路线并返回新对象，天然兼容 `--foo-bar=x` 命令行风格，值按 YAML 规则解析。继承链 Config → ModuleConfig（`build()`）→ ModelConfig（`num_params`）→ TransformerConfig（含 `olmo2_190M` 等工厂方法）。关键术语：dotlist、round-trip、`_CLASS_`、StrEnum、DType。本讲为 u2-l2（Registrable 与 `type` 字段）和 u2-l3（命令行覆盖链路）铺垫。
### u2-l2 Registrable 与多态配置字段

本讲核心是 Registrable 注册机制与多态配置字段，承接上讲的 Config 基类。Registrable 是外部包 dataclass-extensions 提供的 mixin，通过「@基类.register("名字")」装饰器把子类登记进基类名下的「名字→类」注册表（子类自身注册表为空）。序列化时 as_config_dict() 为每个多态节点写双线索：_CLASS_（完整类路径，精确门牌号）与 type（注册名，花名）；反序列化时 _CLASS_ 优先、解析成功即删除 type，手写 YAML 仅凭 type 由 decode 查基类注册表选定子类。多态字段即类型标注为基类的字段（如 optim: OptimConfig、sequence_mixer: SequenceMixerConfig），优化器、调度器、注意力后端、数据加载器四族均采用此模式，换实现只需换子类或 YAML 里的 type 字符串，build() 是统一构建出口；MuP/CompletedP 等缩放规则则选择组合字段而非注册子类。这为下讲 dotlist 命令行覆盖多态字段奠定基础。
### u2-l3 命令行覆盖与 dotlist 合并：官方脚本入口的秘密

本讲拆解 `Config.merge()` 的 dotlist 覆盖机制与 `script_utils` 官方脚本入口。核心结论：覆盖发生在「字典世界」——merge 先用 `_clean_opt` 清洗覆盖项（值按 YAML 规则解析、无等号默认 true、连字符归一为下划线），把配置树降级为字典，经 `_set_nested` 按点号下钻写入，再由 `from_dict` 依 `_CLASS_`/`type` 线索重建新对象，多态子类身份不丢失；`strict` 与 `prefix` 参数分别支持宽松忽略和剥前缀。`get_cli_parser()` 借 `parse_known_args` 把命令行分流为少量正式选项（`--save-folder` 唯一必填）与任意 dotlist 覆盖。`ExperimentConfig` 是五块积木（model/dataset/data_loader/train_module/trainer）的顶层配置，`main()` 串起参数解析、环境准备、组件 build、配置落盘与 `trainer.fit`，`--dry-run` 可零 GPU 预览最终配置。官方脚本以「代码定基线、命令行 merge 微调」收尾，最终配置经 `ConfigSaverCallback` 固化进每个 checkpoint 的 config.json，形成可复现闭环。
### u3-l1 Transformer 总体架构：从 token 到 logits

本讲在单卡视角讲解 OLMo-core 前向主链路的两个模块。顶层 Transformer 只做编排：embedding 查表、N 个 block 顺序前向、lm_head 投影出 logits 并计算交叉熵（返回 LMOutputWithLoss），另有 NormalizedTransformer、MoETransformer 等变体直接继承它；形状只在前向两端变化，中间是 d_model 等宽的残差流。TransformerBlock 约定「同形进同形出」，每层含注意力与前馈两个子层，各配 norm 与 ResidualStream——残差相加被独立成无参模块，支持 alpha 缩放，为回调观测与 CompletedP 参数化预留挂载点。核心结论：OLMo 2 默认采用 reordered_norm 摆法（norm 在子层输出、残差相加之前），而非 pre-norm；block 的 attention 字段实为可插拔 sequence_mixer 插槽；blocks 逐层独立实例化、互不共享参数；embeddings 与 lm_head 可为 None 系流水线并行的直通设计；apply_* 方法群在 build 之后由训练模块原地改造模型以接入各类并行。
### u3-l2 TransformerConfig 与预置架构工厂方法

本讲主讲 `nn/transformer/config.py`：`TransformerConfig` 是描述模型全部形状的「图纸」，五个必填字段 `d_model`、`vocab_size`、`n_layers`、`block`、`lm_head` 定骨架，构造时即校验非法组合。`block` 有三种组织方式——单 block、命名 block 配 `block_pattern` 循环、`block_overrides` 逐层覆盖，由 `resolved_block_configs` 统一为每层一份配置；`build()` 按实现类型分发构建模型，支持 meta 设备占位与通配冻结参数；`num_params` 无需实例化即可精确预算参数量。预置工厂方法构成三层金字塔：规模档位（olmo2/olmo3 系列）委托架构预设（llama2 等）再委托家族装配（`llama_like`），配合 kwargs 覆盖，一行调用既选档位又改任意深层参数；olmo3 预设即 olmo2 加滑窗注意力模式与 flash_2 后端。关键术语：GQA（`n_kv_heads` 小于 `n_heads`）、`reordered_norm` 布局、RoPE theta、FFN 宽度推导公式，以及新增的可选 CompletedP 参数化字段 `completedp`（默认 None 不启用，机制留待后续讲义展开）。
### u3-l3 注意力机制与可插拔后端

本讲聚焦 olmo_core 的 nn/attention 模块（base、attention、backend、ring、kv_cache 等）。核心结论：Transformer block 的 attention 属性是 SequenceMixer 可插拔插槽，仅约定 TP/CP 接入、FLOPs 估算与权重初始化；Attention 是其标准多头自注意力实现，前向依次为 QKV 投影、QK norm、RoPE、SDPA、门控、输出投影，其中仅 SDPA 一步委托给可替换的 AttentionBackend。六种后端（torch、flex、flash_2/3/4、te）经 AttentionConfig.backend 枚举字段切换，用构造期能力断言声明各自边界，选择顺序为显式指定＞旧 use_flash＞SWA 自动选 flash_2＞默认 torch，无 GPU 时回落 torch。引入的关键术语：序列混合器插槽、GQA/MQA、滑动窗口注意力、KV cache、varlen（cu_doc_lens）、or/and 掩码、上下文并行（Ring/Ulysses 风格与 zig-zag/llama3 负载均衡），供后续核心组件与并行讲义承接。
### u3-l4 核心组件：前馈网络、LayerNorm、RoPE 与 LM Head

本讲拆解 Transformer 的四大积木。门控前馈 FeedForward 公式为 w2(act(w1x)⊙w3x)，SwiGLU 与 GeGLU 仅靠 activation 字段切换，参数量约 3dh、hidden 常取 8/3·d_model；归一化家族以 RMSNorm 为主力，weight_shape 与统计范围解耦以支持 QK-norm 每头增益，output_scale 把常数乘子折进增益、由 CompletedP 残差缩放消费；RoPE 由逆频率表生成 sin/cos 并按配置命名空间缓存，ABF/PI/Stepwise/YaRN 四种 scaling 通过改写频率表实现上下文扩展；LMHead 打包最终归一化、logits 裁剪、交叉熵/z-loss 与 fused_linear 免物化 logits 的 loss 实现，tie_word_embeddings 直接共享张量、省 d_model×vocab 参数且要求无 bias；SplitVocabEmbedding 拆「基础+扩展」词表服务多模态。核心结论：这些组件族均采用「name 枚举 + build() 分发」的多态模式而非 Registrable 注册表，自定义变体的零改库入口是子类化 Config 并覆写 build()。
### u3-l5 混合专家（MoE）：路由、专家与负载均衡

本讲拆解 Olmo-core 的 MoE 层：路由器按 top-k 为每个 token 选路，N 个专家 MLP 与可选共享专家顶替 block 中的稠密前馈位，实现总参数大而每个 token 仅激活 K 个专家的稀疏结构。专家计算走 permute—分组计算—unpermute 三段式：容量型实现丢弃超出容量的 token，Dropless 型按需分组、不丢 token。负载均衡损失的读数含义为 1 即完美均衡、趋近 N/K 即路由坍缩；Z 损失压制路由 logits 量级；辅助损失经自定义 autograd 函数挂进计算图反传，权重默认按层数缩放；bias_gamma 提供无辅助损失的偏置均衡路线。MoE 完整前向依赖编译好的 CUDA 内核，router 与损失可在 CPU 单独实验。
### u3-l6 模型初始化：权重从哪里来

本讲围绕 `transformer/init.py`、`TransformerConfig` 的初始化字段与 `Transformer.init_weights()` 展开。核心结论：`build()` 不填权重，须显式调用 `init_weights()`，按 embedding→逐 block（注意力/前馈/MoE）→LM head 顺序分发，各组件自行解释 `InitMethod`。六种方法（normal、llama、llama_depth、normalized、fan_in、nanochat）的差异在基准标准差与是否深度缩放（llama 系对输出侧投影乘 1/√(2N)）；新引入的 nanochat 采用谱条件公式 std=1/√fan_in·min(1,√(fan_out/fan_in))，基于截断正态采样，忽略 init_std，覆盖注意力、KDA、GatedDeltaNet 与稠密/MoE 前馈，融合矩阵按输出维切块处理。可复现性双轨：init_seed 走专属 torch.Generator（流水线并行下按 pp_rank+part_idx×pp_size 偏移），seed_all 播种全局 RNG；`_apply_init`+`distribute_like` 保证 DTensor 分片与单机初始化一致。
### u4-l1 NumpyDataset：预分词数据的内存映射加载

本讲是数据加载单元的第一讲，覆盖预分词数据集、数据加载器、collator 与分词器元信息四个模块。核心结论：OLMo-core 的数据底座是无文件头的裸无符号整型数组（须用 np.memmap 而非 np.save 生成），按字节偏移直读，内存映射使 TB 级语料只占实际访问页的内存；同一 token 流可组织成多种数据集变体——FSL 定长切块（默认）、Padded 按文档补齐、Packed 装箱、Interleaved 交错、VSL 分桶课程学习——均经 NumpyDatasetConfig 子类 build() 构建，prepare() 生成落盘索引缓存。NumpyDataLoader 提供三大保证：确定性（seed 加 epoch 洗牌、全局索引落盘共享）、可恢复（state_dict 含数据指纹校验与已处理批数跳批）、分布式不重不漏（batch 内按数据并行 rank 切片）；直接使用须先 reshuffle 后 reset。关键术语：global_batch_size 以 token 计、rank_batch_size 须被序列长度整除、TokenizerConfig 仅携带词表与特殊 token 元信息而非分词逻辑、DataCollator 负责补齐堆叠与词表越界校验、label_mask 使 padding 位置不计损失。下一讲进入 Composable 数据管线。
### u4-l2 Composable 数据管线：TokenSource → InstanceSource → DataLoader

本讲介绍 OLMo-core 推荐的新一代数据 API（data/composable/），以三层可组合抽象取代「一类一变体」的 NumpyDataset：TokenSource（一维 token 数组，契约含 fingerprint/children）→ InstanceSource（定长训练样本）→ ComposableDataLoader（注册名 composable）。DocumentSource 额外提供文档边界；实例生成器分 ConcatAndChunk（无视边界切块、零 padding）与 Packing（OBFD 整文档装箱、pad 处 label_mask=False）。组合子 +、*、sample、split 与 MixingTokenSource 支撑切片、上采样与按比例混合；calculate_sample_sizes 以归一化、重复上限与整体收缩因子决定各源实际采样量，核心结论是切分必须先于混合，否则串行布局破坏比例。DataLoader 负责 reshuffle 落盘全局索引、按 DP rank 不重不漏切批、指纹校验断点续训；ShuffleStrategy 与 sources_per_epoch 声明课程学习；visualize() 打印源树是首要调试工具。
### u4-l3 数据混合：source_mixture 与预置 mixes

本讲覆盖 OLMo-core 数据混合的三条路线。官方 .txt 配方（DataMix 枚举）每行 label,path，含 {TOKENIZER} 占位符适配分词器，比例靠路径重复隐式表达上采样；SourceMixture 三件套（Config/List/DatasetConfig）把配方（target_ratio 之和必须为 1）与实验参数（requested_tokens、global_batch_size）分离，build() 按文件字节数统计 token，以 Hamilton 最大余数法把实例配额分摊到各文件，产出「每文件取多少 token」清单，源可用上限为 max_source_fraction 与 max_repetition_ratio 之积，容量不足直接报错；composable 路线的 MixingInstanceSource 借 calculate_sample_sizes 自动归一化比例，并以整体收缩因子实现「比例守恒的最少丢弃」分配，由 SamplingInstanceSource 执行采样与索引落盘。验证占比可用构建日志、visualize() 源树或统计 batch 内 token 频次。
### u5-l1 优化器配置体系：AdamW、Lion 与参数组覆盖

本讲解读 olmo_core.optim 的优化器配置体系。核心结论：OptimConfig 是可注册（Registrable）基类，统一管理 group_overrides、compile、fixed_fields、mup、completedp 五个公共字段，子类自定义字段经 build() 自动透传为优化器构造参数；build 流程为 build_groups 组装参数组、工厂方法实例化、逐组设 lr 与 initial_lr、快照 fixed_fields 并挂 checkpoint 后置钩子。AdamWConfig 直接包装 torch.optim.AdamW；Lion 为库内自实现（符号更新、单动量、默认 lr 更小）；矩阵感知的 Muon/Dion 走 MatrixAwareOptimConfig，按参数维度自动分组，不支持手动分组与 muP/CompletedP。OptimGroupOverride 用 fnmatch 通配符按全限定参数名把 embedding、lm_head 等拉入独立参数组，未覆盖参数进默认组，strict 模式下匹配为空即抛错。关键术语：参数组（param_groups）、initial_lr（钉入 fixed_fields 防止续训被旧 checkpoint 污染，供 u5-l2 调度器承接）、mup 与 completedp（新增可选字段，仅 AdamW 系支持，详见 u10-l7/u10-l8）。
### u5-l2 学习率调度器

本讲解读 `olmo_core/optim/scheduler.py`：OLMo-core 自研学习率调度体系（共 14 个调度器），而非 torch 内置的 lr_scheduler。`Scheduler` 基类混入 Config 与 Registrable，计算接口是纯函数 `get_lr(initial_lr, current, t_max)`，副作用集中在 `set_lr(group, trainer)`，由 `optim_step` 每步对每个参数组调用；LR 总是从 `initial_lr`（钉在 `fixed_fields`、随 checkpoint 保存）重算，调度幂等、断点续训曲线不漂移，`units` 可按 steps 或 tokens 计进度。主力 `CosWithWarmup`＝线性 warmup＋余弦衰减到 `alpha_f`·峰值（默认 0.1，并不衰到零），`warmup` 与 `warmup_fraction` 恰给其一，`t_max` 可覆盖总步数。核心结论：余弦曲线相对总步数（horizon）定义，换阶段必须重设曲线——OLMo-3 三阶段即 `CosWithWarmup` → `HalfCosWithWarmup`（从余弦中点接管退火并重设 lr）→ `LinearWithWarmup` 衰到 0。组合件还有 `SequentialScheduler`（前段终点 LR 作后段 initial_lr）与 `PerGroupScheduler`（配合 `OptimGroupOverride` 按参数组分派）。
### u5-l3 SkipStepOptimizer：loss spike 检测与梯度裁剪

本讲覆盖训练稳定性防线，应对 loss spike(损失尖峰)：SkipStepOptimizer 基类维护 loss 与梯度范数的滚动窗口(默认 128 步)，以均值+kσ(默认 6σ)单边判据检测异常步；判定结果 step_factor 是留在设备上的 0/1 张量，乘进更新公式而非提前 return,避免 host-device 同步并保证各 rank 决策一致。SkipStepAdamW 把 step_factor 织入公式每一项(含内部 step 计数)，跳步是严格 no-op,OLMo 官方配方默认采用。梯度裁剪位于 optim_step() 内、step() 之前：latest_loss 须提前跨 rank 归约，latest_grad_norm 复用裁剪前总范数，两者须先于 step() 就位(时序契约)；OLMoDDPOptimizer 则把裁剪与跳步内化进自身 step()。grad_debug 的 debug_nan_inf_grad_norm 零开销早退、定位 NaN/Inf 梯度元凶。结论：裁剪压小梯度但仍执行，跳步整步放弃，二者互补。

import os
import tempfile
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.distributed as dist

from olmo_core.eval.task_groups import TASK_GROUPS

from ..config import Config
from ..data import DataLoaderBase, TokenizerConfig
from ..exceptions import OLMoConfigurationError
from ..io import is_url
from ..utils import get_default_device
from .callbacks import Callback, CallbackConfig
from .checkpoint import CheckpointerConfig
from .common import Duration, LoadStrategy, StepSkipRange
from .train_module import TrainModule
from .trainer import Trainer


@dataclass
class TrainerConfig(Config):
    """
    A configuration class for easily building :class:`Trainer` instances.

    .. seealso::
        See the :class:`Trainer` documentation for a description of the fields.
    """

    save_folder: str

    work_dir: Optional[str] = None
    load_path: Optional[str] = None
    load_strategy: LoadStrategy = LoadStrategy.if_available
    load_optim_state: Optional[bool] = None
    load_trainer_state: Optional[bool] = None
    checkpointer: CheckpointerConfig = field(default_factory=CheckpointerConfig)

    device: Optional[str] = None
    save_overwrite: bool = False
    max_duration: Duration = field(default_factory=lambda: Duration.epochs(1))
    cancel_check_interval: int = 25
    hard_stop: Optional[Duration] = None
    metrics_collect_interval: int = 5
    callbacks: Dict[str, Callback] = field(default_factory=dict)
    async_bookkeeping: Optional[bool] = None
    bookkeeping_soft_timeout: int = 30
    no_checkpoints: bool = False
    no_evals: bool = False
    steps_to_skip: Optional[List[StepSkipRange]] = None
    checkpoints_to_eval: Optional[List[str]] = None
    """
    Checkpoint paths (or globs) to evaluate with :meth:`Trainer.eval_checkpoints`. No effect during
    training.
    """

    def add_callback(self, name: str, callback: Callback):
        """
        Add another callback.
        """
        if name in self.callbacks:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(f"A callback with name '{name}' already exists")
        self.callbacks[name] = callback

    def add_callbacks(self, callbacks: Dict[str, Callback]):
        """
        Add a set of callbacks.
        """
        for name, callback in callbacks.items():
            self.add_callback(name, callback)

    def with_callback(self, name: str, callback: Callback) -> "TrainerConfig":
        """
        Return a new trainer config with an additional callback.

        :param name: A name to assign the callback. Must be unique.
        :param callback: The callback to add.
        """
        out = replace(self, callbacks=deepcopy(self.callbacks))
        out.add_callback(name, callback)
        return out

    def with_callbacks(self, callbacks: Dict[str, Callback]) -> "TrainerConfig":
        """
        Return a new trainer config with additional callbacks.

        :param callbacks: A dictionary of callbacks to add. Keys must be unique.
        """
        out = replace(self, callbacks=deepcopy(self.callbacks))
        out.add_callbacks(callbacks)
        return out

    def with_recommended_evals(
        self,
        tokenizer: TokenizerConfig,
        sequence_length: int,
        cluster: str,
        task_set: str = "full",
        eval_interval: int = 10_000,
        lazy_load: bool = False,
    ) -> "TrainerConfig":
        """
        Return a new trainer config with added callbacks for downstream evaluation and validation sets.
        """
        from olmo_core.data import DataMix, NumpyPaddedFSLDatasetConfig
        from olmo_core.internal.common import get_root_dir, get_work_dir
        from olmo_core.train.callbacks import (
            DownstreamEvaluatorCallbackConfig,
            LMEvaluatorCallbackConfig,
        )

        try:
            tasks = TASK_GROUPS[task_set]
        except KeyError as e:
            raise ValueError(f"Task set not recognized: {task_set}") from e

        tasks.sort()

        return self.with_callback(
            "downstream_evaluator",
            DownstreamEvaluatorCallbackConfig(
                tasks=tasks,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                eval_interval=eval_interval,
                lazy=lazy_load,
                eval_on_finish=True,
            ),
        ).with_callback(
            "lm_evaluator",
            LMEvaluatorCallbackConfig(
                eval_dataset=NumpyPaddedFSLDatasetConfig.from_data_mix(
                    DataMix.v3_small_ppl_validation,
                    mix_base_dir=get_root_dir(cluster),
                    sequence_length=sequence_length,
                    tokenizer=tokenizer,
                    work_dir=get_work_dir(get_root_dir(cluster)),
                ),
                eval_interval=eval_interval,
                eval_on_finish=True,
            ),
        )

    def build(
        self,
        train_module: TrainModule,
        data_loader: DataLoaderBase,
        *,
        eval_only: bool = False,
        dp_process_group: Optional[dist.ProcessGroup] = None,
        checkpointer_pg: Optional[dist.ProcessGroup] = None,
    ) -> Trainer:
        """
        Build the corresponding trainer.

        :param train_module: The train module to fit.
        :param data_loader: The data loader to train on.
        :param eval_only: Accepted for a uniform calling convention with the train-module config's
            ``build()`` (which uses it to skip building the optimizer). The trainer itself needs no
            special eval-only state, so it's ignored here.
        :param dp_process_group: The data parallel process group. Defaults to
            :data:`olmo_core.train.train_module.TrainModule.dp_process_group`.
        """
        del eval_only

        kwargs = self.as_dict(exclude_none=True, recurse=False)

        if dp_process_group is None:
            dp_process_group = train_module.dp_process_group

        device = kwargs.pop("device", None)

        work_dir = kwargs.pop("work_dir", None)
        if work_dir is None:
            if not is_url(self.save_folder):
                work_dir = self.save_folder
            else:
                work_dir = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), os.path.basename(self.save_folder))
        elif is_url(work_dir):
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"Trainer 'work_dir' must be a local path, not a URL ('{work_dir}')"
            )

        checkpointer_kwargs = {}
        if self.checkpointer.save_overwrite is None:
            checkpointer_kwargs["save_overwrite"] = self.save_overwrite
        if self.checkpointer.work_dir is None:
            checkpointer_kwargs["work_dir"] = work_dir
        checkpointer = kwargs.pop("checkpointer").build(
            process_group=checkpointer_pg, **checkpointer_kwargs
        )

        all_callbacks = kwargs.pop("callbacks")
        callbacks = {k: cb for k, cb in all_callbacks.items() if not isinstance(cb, CallbackConfig)}
        callback_configs = {
            k: cb for k, cb in all_callbacks.items() if isinstance(cb, CallbackConfig)
        }

        trainer = Trainer(
            train_module=train_module,
            data_loader=data_loader,
            checkpointer=checkpointer,
            work_dir=Path(work_dir),
            device=torch.device(device) if device is not None else get_default_device(),
            dp_process_group=dp_process_group,
            callbacks=callbacks,
            **kwargs,
        )

        for cb_name, cb_config in callback_configs.items():
            cb = cb_config.build(trainer)
            if cb is not None:
                trainer.add_callback(cb_name, cb)

        return trainer

331	    def __post_init__(self):
332	        self.save_folder = normalize_path(self.save_folder)
333	        if self.load_path is not None:
334	            self.load_path = normalize_path(self.load_path)
335	
336	        # If save folder is a local directory, make sure we're using a shared filesystem.
337	        if not is_url(self.save_folder) and get_fs_local_rank() != get_rank():
338	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
339	                "Checkpointing to a local directory requires a shared filesystem. "
340	                "If you do have a shared filesystem please set the env var 'OLMO_SHARED_FS=1' "
341	                "or set 'FS_LOCAL_RANK' to the global rank for each process."
342	            )
343	
344	        # Validate working directory.
345	        if is_url(self.work_dir):
346	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
347	                f"Trainer working directory must be a local path, got a URL instead ('{self.work_dir}')."
348	            )
349	        self.work_dir = Path(normalize_path(self.work_dir))
350	
351	        # Ensure save folder and working directory exist.
352	        if get_fs_local_rank() == 0:
353	            self.work_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
354	            if not is_url(self.save_folder):
355	                Path(self.save_folder).mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
356	
357	        # Ensure we have necessary callbacks.
358	        if not self.has_callback(ConsoleLoggerCallback):
359	            self.callbacks.setdefault(
360	                "console_logger",
361	                ConsoleLoggerCallback(metrics_log_interval=self.metrics_collect_interval),
362	            )
363	        if not self.has_callback(CheckpointerCallback):
364	            self.callbacks.setdefault("checkpointer", CheckpointerCallback())
365	        if not self.has_callback(SpeedMonitorCallback):
366	            self.callbacks.setdefault("speed_monitor", SpeedMonitorCallback())
367	        if not self.has_callback(GarbageCollectorCallback):
368	            self.callbacks.setdefault("garbage_collector", GarbageCollectorCallback())
369	
370	        # Set pointer to self in all callbacks.
371	        for callback in self.callbacks.values():
372	            callback.trainer = self
373	
374	        # Sort callbacks by (priority, name).
375	        # We do this for 2 reasons: (1) to respect the priority, and (2) to ensure the callback
376	        # order is consistent across the process group since some callbacks make distributed
377	        # synchronization/communication calls.
378	        self._sort_callbacks()
379	
380	        if self.dp_process_group is None:
381	            self.dp_process_group = self.train_module.dp_process_group
382	
383	        # Maybe create separate process group for bookkeeping.
384	        if self._bookkeeping_pg is None and is_distributed():
385	            if self.async_bookkeeping is None:
386	                self.async_bookkeeping = backend_supports_cpu()
387	            if self.async_bookkeeping:
388	                if not backend_supports_cpu():
389	                    raise OLMoConfigurationError(
390	                        "A CPU-only backend is required for async bookkeeping"
391	                    )
392	                log.info("Creating new process group for async bookkeeping")
393	                self._bookkeeping_pg = dist.new_group()
394	
395	        # Check data loader configuration.
396	        if self.data_loader.dp_world_size != get_world_size(self.dp_process_group):
397	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
398	                "data loader's DP world size appears to be configured incorrectly, "
399	                f"got {self.data_loader.dp_world_size}, expected {get_world_size(self.dp_process_group)}."
400	            )
401	        if self.data_loader.dp_rank != get_rank(self.dp_process_group):
402	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
403	                "data loader's DP rank appears to be configured incorrectly, "
404	                f"got {self.data_loader.dp_rank}, expected {get_rank(self.dp_process_group)}."
405	            )
406	        if self.data_loader.fs_local_rank != get_fs_local_rank():
407	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
408	                "data loader's FS local rank appears to be configured incorrectly, "
409	                f"got {self.data_loader.fs_local_rank}, expected {get_fs_local_rank()}."
410	            )
411	
412	        for callback in self.callbacks.values():
413	            callback.post_attach()
414	
415	        self.train_module._attach_trainer(self)

503	    def convert_duration_to_steps(self, duration: Duration) -> int:
504	        """Convert a duration to steps."""
505	        if duration.unit == DurationUnit.epochs:
506	            if self.steps_per_epoch is None:
507	                raise RuntimeError(
508	                    "the number of steps cannot be determined from an 'epochs' duration since "
509	                    "the data loader's number of batches is unknown"
510	                )
511	            return self.steps_per_epoch * duration.value
512	        elif duration.unit == DurationUnit.steps:
513	            return duration.value
514	        elif duration.unit == DurationUnit.tokens:
515	            raise RuntimeError("the number of steps cannot be determined from a 'tokens' duration")
516	        else:
517	            raise NotImplementedError(f"Unsupported duration unit: {duration.unit}")
518	
519	    def _get_max_steps(self, duration: Duration) -> Optional[int]:
520	        if duration.unit == DurationUnit.steps:
521	            return duration.value
522	        elif duration.unit == DurationUnit.epochs:
523	            if self.data_loader.total_batches is None:
524	                return None
525	            max_epochs = duration.value
526	            # NOTE: need to cover the case where the last epoch has just ended and we've incremented
527	            # self.epoch.
528	            steps_remaining_this_epoch = (
529	                0
530	                if self.epoch > max_epochs
531	                else max(self.data_loader.total_batches - self.data_loader.batches_processed, 0)
532	            )
533	            steps_remaining = steps_remaining_this_epoch
534	            for e in range(self.epoch + 1, duration.value + 1):
535	                if (b := self.data_loader.batches_in_epoch(e)) is not None:
536	                    steps_remaining += b
537	                else:
538	                    return None
539	            return self.global_step + steps_remaining
540	        elif duration.unit == DurationUnit.tokens:
541	            # Need to account for a change in batch size.
542	            max_tokens = duration.value
543	            tokens_remaining = max(max_tokens - self.global_train_tokens_seen, 0)
544	            steps_remaining = math.ceil(tokens_remaining / self.tokens_per_batch)
545	            return self.global_step + steps_remaining
546	        else:
547	            raise NotImplementedError
548	
549	    def _get_max_tokens(self, duration: Duration) -> Optional[int]:
550	        if duration.unit == DurationUnit.tokens:
551	            return duration.value
552	        else:
553	            max_steps = self._get_max_steps(duration)
554	            if max_steps is None:
555	                return None
556	            steps_remaining = max(max_steps - self.global_step, 0)
557	            tokens_remaining = steps_remaining * self.tokens_per_batch
558	            return self.global_train_tokens_seen + tokens_remaining

611	    @property
612	    def training_progress(self) -> TrainingProgress:
613	        # Calculate total steps.
614	        total_steps = (
615	            self._get_max_steps(self.hard_stop) if self.hard_stop is not None else self.max_steps
616	        )
617	        if total_steps is not None:
618	            total_steps = max(total_steps, self.global_step)
619	
620	        # Get current speed in batches per second.
621	        bps: Optional[float] = None
622	        tps: Optional[float] = None
623	        mfu: Optional[float] = None
624	        for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
625	            if isinstance(callback, SpeedMonitorCallback):
626	                bps = callback.bps_avg
627	                tps = callback.tps_avg
628	                mfu = callback.mfu_avg
629	                break
630	
631	        # Estimate the remaining time.
632	        time_remaining: Optional[timedelta] = None
633	        if (
634	            bps is not None
635	            and total_steps is not None
636	            and (steps_remaining := (total_steps - self.global_step)) > 0
637	        ):
638	            seconds_remaining = steps_remaining / bps
639	            # Round to nearest minute.
640	            minutes_remaining = 1 + (seconds_remaining // 60)
641	            time_remaining = timedelta(minutes=minutes_remaining)
642	
643	        return TrainingProgress(
644	            current_step=self.global_step,
645	            current_tokens=self.global_train_tokens_seen,
646	            total_steps=total_steps,
647	            time_remaining=time_remaining,
648	            bps=bps,
649	            tps=tps,
650	            mfu=mfu,
651	        )

659	    def cancel_run(self, reason: str, no_sync: bool = False):
660	        """
661	        Mark the run canceled.
662	
663	        :param reason: The reason for canceling.
664	        :param no_sync: Set this to ``True`` only if you're calling this from all ranks at the same
665	            time, otherwise you'll get a distributed deadlock.
666	        """
667	        if self.is_canceled:
668	            return
669	
670	        self._canceling_rank = get_rank()
671	        self._cancel_reason = reason

677	    def check_if_canceled(self):
678	        """
679	        Asynchronously check if the run is canceled. Use :data:`is_canceled` to see the result.
680	        This needs to be called by all ranks at the same point in the training loop.
681	        """
682	        # NOTE: Do not set `allow_multiple` to `False` here!
683	        # That could result in a situation where this op is canceled on one rank while it's running
684	        # on another rank, leading to a deadlock.
685	        self.run_bookkeeping_op(self._check_if_canceled)

687	    def fit(self):
688	        """
689	        Fit the model, potentially loading a checkpoint first depending on the
690	        :data:`load_strategy`.
691	        """
692	        self._canceled = False
693	        self._cancel_reason = None
694	        self._canceling_rank = None
695	
696	        # Maybe load a checkpoint.
697	        if (
698	            not self.no_checkpoints
699	            and not self.checkpoint_loaded
700	            and self.load_strategy != LoadStrategy.never
701	        ):
702	            # Try loading from the save folder first. The save folder is used for continuing
703	            # existing runs that failed or were preempted, so we always load trainer state and
704	            # optimizer state.
705	            self.maybe_load_checkpoint(
706	                self.save_folder, load_trainer_state=True, load_optim_state=True
707	            )
708	
709	            # Then fallback to the load path, if provided.
710	            if self.load_path is not None:
711	                if not self.checkpoint_loaded:
712	                    self.maybe_load_checkpoint(self.load_path)
713	                else:
714	                    log.warning(
715	                        f"Ignoring load path ('{self.load_path}') since checkpoint was found in save folder"
716	                    )
717	
718	            if not self.checkpoint_loaded:
719	                if self.load_strategy == LoadStrategy.always:
720	                    raise FileNotFoundError(
721	                        f"No checkpoint found in save folder ('{self.save_folder}') or "
722	                        f"load path ('{self.load_path}')"
723	                    )
724	                else:
725	                    log.warning(
726	                        f"No checkpoint found in save folder ('{self.save_folder}') or "
727	                        f"load path ('{self.load_path}'), will train from scratch..."
728	                    )
729	
730	        barrier()
731	
732	        log.info("Callback order:")
733	        for i, callback_name in enumerate(self.callbacks.keys()):
734	            log.info(f"  - Callback {i + 1}: {callback_name}")
735	
736	        if self.max_steps is not None:
737	            log.info(f"Training for {self.max_steps:,d} steps")
738	
739	        # Install SIGTERM + SIGINT handlers.
740	        og_sigterm_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, self._handle_os_signal)
741	        og_sigint_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, self._handle_os_signal)
742	
743	        try:
744	            for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
745	                callback.pre_train()
746	            self.train_module.pre_train()
747	
748	            # Quick check if the run has already been canceled.
749	            if self.is_canceled:
750	                for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
751	                    callback.post_train()
752	                self._shutdown()
753	                return
754	
755	            # Do a dry-run for compiling and catching OOMs early.
756	            if not self.training_complete:
757	                self._dry_run_batch()
758	
759	            # Iterate over epochs until done.
760	            while not self.training_complete:
761	                self._fit_epoch()
762	        except BaseException as exc:
763	            self._error = exc
764	            log.error(f"Training failed due to:\n{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
765	            for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
766	                callback.on_error(exc)
767	            # Shutdown ungracefully, i.e. without waiting on bookkeeping ops to finish and without
768	            # issuing additional distributed collectives because those could result in a deadlock
769	            # considering we're already in a bad/inconsistent state across ranks.
770	            self._shutdown(gracefully=False)
771	            raise
772	        finally:
773	            # Restore original signal handlers.
774	            signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, og_sigterm_handler)
775	            signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, og_sigint_handler)
776	
777	        for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
778	            callback.post_train()
779	
780	        # Wait for any bookkeeping tasks to finish.
781	        self._shutdown()
782	        log.info("Training complete")
783	
784	    def eval_checkpoints(self):
785	        """
786	        Evaluate each checkpoint in :data:`checkpoints_to_eval` with the configured
787	        :class:`~olmo_core.train.callbacks.EvaluatorCallback`\\ s, without training.
788	
789	        Loads each checkpoint in turn, runs every evaluator, and logs the results. Checkpointer and
790	        evaluator callbacks' ``pre_train``/``post_train`` hooks are skipped (only the evaluators'
791	        ``perform_eval()`` runs).
792	
793	        :raises OLMoConfigurationError: If ``no_evals=True``, no ``EvaluatorCallback`` is configured,
794	            or ``checkpoints_to_eval`` is unset.
795	        """
796	        if self.no_evals:
797	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
798	                f"'{self.__class__.__name__}.eval_checkpoints()' requires 'no_evals=False'"
799	            )
800	
801	        checkpoint_paths = self._get_checkpoints_to_eval()
802	        evaluator_callbacks = [
803	            cb for cb in self._iter_callbacks() if isinstance(cb, EvaluatorCallback)
804	        ]
805	        if not evaluator_callbacks:
806	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
807	                f"'{self.__class__.__name__}.eval_checkpoints()' requires at least one "
808	                f"'{EvaluatorCallback.__name__}'"
809	            )
810	
811	        self._canceled = False
812	        self._cancel_reason = None
813	        self._canceling_rank = None
814	
815	        log.info("Callback order:")
816	        for i, callback_name in enumerate(self.callbacks.keys()):
817	            log.info(f"  - Callback {i + 1}: {callback_name}")
818	
819	        log.info(f"Evaluating {len(checkpoint_paths):,d} checkpoints")
820	
821	        callback_blacklist = (CheckpointerCallback, EvaluatorCallback)
822	
823	        # Install SIGTERM + SIGINT handlers.
824	        og_sigterm_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, self._handle_os_signal)
825	        og_sigint_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, self._handle_os_signal)
826	
827	        try:
828	            for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
829	                if not isinstance(callback, callback_blacklist):
830	                    callback.pre_train()
831	            self.train_module.pre_train()
832	
833	            if self.is_canceled:
834	                for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
835	                    if not isinstance(callback, callback_blacklist):
836	                        callback.post_train()
837	                self._shutdown()
838	                return
839	
840	            for checkpoint_num, checkpoint_path in enumerate(checkpoint_paths, start=1):
841	                if self.is_canceled:
842	                    break
843	
844	                log.info(
845	                    f"Evaluating checkpoint {checkpoint_num:,d}/{len(checkpoint_paths):,d} "
846	                    f"from '{checkpoint_path}'..."
847	                )
848	                # Offline eval only needs model weights: skip optimizer state (never needed, and
849	                # eval-only/weights-only checkpoints have none), and leave trainer state at the
850	                # trainer's default (load-if-present) so it isn't required either.
851	                self.load_checkpoint(checkpoint_path, load_optim_state=False)
852	
853	                self.record_metric("throughput/total tokens", self.global_train_tokens_seen)
854	                # Duck-typed so this stays train-module-agnostic (transformer train modules expose
855	                # these; the base TrainModule doesn't).
856	                num_flops_fn = getattr(self.train_module, "num_flops_per_token", None)
857	                max_seq_len = getattr(self.train_module, "max_sequence_length", None)
858	                if callable(num_flops_fn) and max_seq_len is not None:
859	                    num_flops_per_token = num_flops_fn(max_seq_len)
860	                    if num_flops_per_token is not None:
861	                        self.record_metric(
862	                            "throughput/total petaflops",
863	                            self.global_train_tokens_seen * num_flops_per_token / 1e15,
864	                        )
865	
866	                for callback in evaluator_callbacks:
867	                    callback.perform_eval()
868	
869	                self._log_metrics()
870	        except BaseException as exc:
871	            log.error(f"Checkpoint evaluation failed due to:\n{exc}")
872	            for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
873	                if not isinstance(callback, callback_blacklist):
874	                    callback.on_error(exc)
875	            for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
876	                callback.close()
877	            raise
878	        finally:
879	            # Restore original signal handlers.
880	            signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, og_sigterm_handler)
881	            signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, og_sigint_handler)
882	
883	        # Flush metrics + await queued bookkeeping ops before the post-train hooks run.
884	        self._log_metrics()
885	        self._join_bookkeeping_ops()
886	        for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
887	            if not isinstance(callback, callback_blacklist):
888	                callback.post_train()
889	
890	        self._shutdown()
891	        log.info("Checkpoint evaluation complete")

893	    def _get_checkpoints_to_eval(self) -> List[str]:
894	        if not self.checkpoints_to_eval:
895	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
896	                f"'{self.__class__.__name__}.eval_checkpoints()' requires "
897	                "'checkpoints_to_eval' to be set"
898	            )
899	
900	        checkpoint_paths: List[str] = []
901	        error_type: Optional[str] = None
902	        error_msg: Optional[str] = None
903	
904	        if get_rank() == 0:
905	            seen = set()
906	            try:
907	                for raw_path in self.checkpoints_to_eval:
908	                    path = normalize_path(raw_path)
909	                    candidate_paths = sorted(glob_directory(path)) if "*" in path else [path]
910	                    if not candidate_paths:
911	                        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No checkpoints found in '{path}'")
912	
913	                    expanded_paths: List[str] = []
914	                    for candidate_path in candidate_paths:
915	                        if self.checkpointer.dir_is_checkpoint(candidate_path):
916	                            expanded_paths.append(candidate_path)
917	                        else:
918	                            expanded_paths.extend(
919	                                checkpoint_path
920	                                for _, checkpoint_path in sorted(
921	                                    self.checkpointer.find_checkpoints(candidate_path),
922	                                    key=lambda item: item[0],
923	                                )
924	                            )
925	
926	                    if not expanded_paths:
927	                        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No checkpoints found in '{path}'")
928	
929	                    for checkpoint_path in expanded_paths:
930	                        if checkpoint_path not in seen:
931	                            checkpoint_paths.append(checkpoint_path)
932	                            seen.add(checkpoint_path)
933	            except FileNotFoundError as exc:
934	                error_type = "FileNotFoundError"
935	                error_msg = str(exc)
936	            except OLMoConfigurationError as exc:
937	                error_type = "OLMoConfigurationError"
938	                error_msg = str(exc)
939	            except Exception as exc:
940	                error_type = exc.__class__.__name__
941	                error_msg = str(exc)
942	
943	        checkpoint_paths, error_type, error_msg = broadcast_object(
944	            (checkpoint_paths, error_type, error_msg)
945	        )
946	
947	        if error_type == "FileNotFoundError":
948	            assert error_msg is not None
949	            raise FileNotFoundError(error_msg)
950	        elif error_type == "OLMoConfigurationError":
951	            assert error_msg is not None
952	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(error_msg)
953	        elif error_type is not None:
954	            assert error_msg is not None
955	            raise RuntimeError(error_msg)
956	
957	        if checkpoint_paths and all(
958	            (name := Path(path).name).startswith("step") and name[4:].isdigit()
959	            for path in checkpoint_paths
960	        ):
961	            checkpoint_paths = sorted(checkpoint_paths, key=lambda path: int(Path(path).name[4:]))
962	
963	        return checkpoint_paths

965	    def _shutdown(self, gracefully: bool = True):
966	        if gracefully:
967	            self._log_metrics()
968	            self._join_bookkeeping_ops()
969	            if self._multi_thread_pool is not None:
970	                self._multi_thread_pool.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=False)
971	                self._multi_thread_pool = None
972	            if self._single_thread_pool is not None:
973	                self._single_thread_pool.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=False)
974	                self._single_thread_pool = None
975	
976	        # NOTE: '.close' must be called after shutting down thread pools to ensure bookkeeping ops
977	        # have finished first. See https://github.com/allenai/Olmo-core/pull/546.
978	        for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
979	            callback.close()
980	
981	        if gracefully:
982	            barrier()
983	
984	        gc_cuda()

1003	        """
1004	        Load trainer state (not model or optimizer state).
1005	        """
1006	        # For backwards compatibility.
1007	        if "data_loader" not in state_dict:
1008	            if "dataset" in state_dict:
1009	                state_dict["data_loader"] = state_dict.pop("dataset")
1010	                state_dict["data_loader"]["epoch"] = state_dict["epoch"]
1011	            else:
1012	                state_dict["data_loader"] = {
1013	                    "dataset_type": "fsl",
1014	                    "dataset_fingerprint_version": state_dict.pop("dataset_fingerprint_version"),
1015	                    "dataset_fingerprint": state_dict.pop("dataset_fingerprint"),
1016	                    "tokens_processed": state_dict["global_train_tokens_seen_this_epoch"],
1017	                    "batches_processed": state_dict["global_train_tokens_seen_this_epoch"]
1018	                    // self.global_batch_size,
1019	                    "sequence_length": state_dict.pop("train_sequence_length"),
1020	                    "max_target_sequence_length": state_dict.pop("max_train_sequence_length"),
1021	                    "seed": state_dict["data_seed"],
1022	                    "epoch": state_dict["epoch"],
1023	                }
1024	
1025	        self.data_loader.load_state_dict(state_dict["data_loader"])
1026	        self.global_step = state_dict["global_step"]
1027	        self.global_train_tokens_seen = state_dict["global_train_tokens_seen"]
1028	        self.global_train_petaflops = state_dict.get("global_train_petaflops", 0.0)
1029	        self.epoch = state_dict["epoch"]
1030	
1031	        for cb_name, cb_state in state_dict.get("callbacks", {}).items():
1032	            if (cb := self.callbacks.get(cb_name)) is not None:
1033	                cb.load_state_dict(cb_state)

1038	            rng_state = EnvRngStates.from_dict(state_dict["rng"])

1040	                log.warning(
1041	                    "Some RNG states were not restored due to differences in library versions"
1042	                )

1044	            log.warning(
1045	                "Trainer will not restore rank RNG states since the RNG states in the checkpoint "
1046	                "were saved with a different world size."

1049	    def load_checkpoint(
1050	        self,
1051	        dir: PathOrStr,
1052	        *,
1053	        load_trainer_state: Optional[bool] = None,
1054	        load_optim_state: Optional[bool] = None,
1055	        reset_optimizer_states_on_load: Optional[bool] = None,
1056	    ):
1057	        """
1058	        Load a checkpoint.
1059	
1060	        .. note::
1061	            :meth:`fit()` may call this method automatically depending on the :data:`load_strategy`.
1062	
1063	        :param dir: The path/URL to a checkpoint or a folder of checkpoints.
1064	        :param load_trainer_state: Load trainer state (data loader state, RNG states, and other bookkeeping).
1065	        :param load_optim_state: Load optimizer state in the train module.
1066	        :param reset_optimizer_states_on_load: Override whether optimizer state should be reset for
1067	            this checkpoint load. When left ``None``, :meth:`Checkpointer.load` defaults it to the
1068	            train module's ``reset_optimizer_states_on_resume`` setting on an actual resume (i.e.
1069	            only when trainer state is found in the checkpoint).
1070	        """
1071	        load_trainer_state = (
1072	            self.load_trainer_state if load_trainer_state is None else load_trainer_state
1073	        )
1074	        load_optim_state = self.load_optim_state if load_optim_state is None else load_optim_state
1075	        if dir == self.save_folder:
1076	            if load_trainer_state is False:
1077	                log.warning(
1078	                    "Loading from save_folder with 'load_trainer_state=False' is not recommended, "
1079	                    "since the save_folder is meant for continuing existing runs."
1080	                )
1081	            if load_optim_state is False:
1082	                log.warning(
1083	                    "Loading from save_folder with 'load_optim_state=False' is not recommended, "
1084	                    "since the save_folder is meant for continuing existing runs."
1085	                )
1086	
1087	        dir = normalize_path(dir)
1088	
1089	        # NOTE: to avoid making a ton of client requests (S3 or otherwise) we only make those
1090	        # requests from rank 0 then scatter the result to the other ranks.
1091	        dir_to_scatter: Optional[PathOrStr] = dir
1092	        error: Optional[Exception] = None
1093	        if get_rank() == 0 and not self.checkpointer.dir_is_checkpoint(dir):
1094	            # Try to find the latest checkpoint in the directory.
1095	            try:
1096	                dir_to_scatter = self.checkpointer.latest_checkpoint(dir)
1097	            except FileNotFoundError as e:  # defer raising until after the scatter
1098	                dir_to_scatter, error = None, e
1099	        dir_to_scatter = broadcast_object(dir_to_scatter)
1100	        if dir_to_scatter is None:
1101	            if error is None:
1102	                raise FileNotFoundError(f"No checkpoints found in '{dir}'")
1103	            raise error
1104	        dir = dir_to_scatter
1105	
1106	        log.info(f"Loading checkpoint from '{dir}'...")
1107	        load_start = time.perf_counter()
1108	        trainer_state = self.checkpointer.load(
1109	            dir,
1110	            self.train_module,
1111	            load_trainer_state=load_trainer_state,
1112	            load_optim_state=load_optim_state,
1113	            reset_optimizer_states_on_load=reset_optimizer_states_on_load,
1114	        )
1115	        if trainer_state is not None:
1116	            self.load_state_dict(cast(TrainerStateDict, trainer_state))
1117	
1118	        self.record_metric(
1119	            "checkpoint/load_duration_s",
1120	            time.perf_counter() - load_start,
1121	            reduce_type=ReduceType.max,
1122	        )
1123	
1124	        for callback in self._iter_callbacks():
1125	            callback.post_checkpoint_loaded(dir)
1126	
1127	        self._checkpoint_loaded = True
1128	        log.info("Checkpoint successfully loaded")

1165	        """

1218	        # operation to be finished first.
1219	        self._log_metrics()
1220	        self._join_bookkeeping_ops()
1221	
1222	        fut = self.checkpointer.save_async(
1223	            path,
1224	            self.train_module,

1244	    def record_metric(
1245	        self,
1246	        name: str,
1247	        value: Union[float, torch.Tensor],
1248	        reduce_type: Optional[ReduceType] = None,
1249	        namespace: Optional[str] = None,
1250	        merge_strategy: MetricMergeStrategy = MetricMergeStrategy.warn,
1251	    ):
1252	        """
1253	        Record a new metric for the current step.
1254	
1255	        .. seealso::
1256	            Use :meth:`record_ce_loss()` to record the cross-entropy loss, specifically.
1257	
1258	        :param name: The name of the metric.
1259	        :param value: The value of the metric.
1260	        :param reduce_type: Specifies how to reduce the metric across the distributed process group.
1261	            ``None`` means no reduction.
1262	        :param namespace: A namespace to record the metric under, i.g. "train" or "optim".
1263	        :param merge_strategy: How to merge metrics when duplicates are logged.
1264	        """
1265	        if namespace is not None:
1266	            name = f"{namespace.rstrip('/')}/{name.lstrip('/')}"
1267	
1268	        value = _metric_value_to_tensor(value)
1269	
1270	        if self.global_step not in self._metrics:
1271	            self._metrics[self.global_step] = OrderedDict()
1272	
1273	        step_metrics = self._metrics[self.global_step]
1274	
1275	        if name not in step_metrics or merge_strategy == MetricMergeStrategy.latest:
1276	            step_metrics[name] = value
1277	        elif merge_strategy == MetricMergeStrategy.sum:
1278	            step_metrics[name] = step_metrics[name] + value
1279	        elif merge_strategy == MetricMergeStrategy.mean:
1280	            step_metrics[name] = (step_metrics[name] + value) / 2
1281	        elif merge_strategy == MetricMergeStrategy.max:
1282	            step_metrics[name] = torch.max(step_metrics[name], value.to(step_metrics[name].device))
1283	        elif merge_strategy == MetricMergeStrategy.min:
1284	            step_metrics[name] = torch.min(step_metrics[name], value.to(step_metrics[name].device))
1285	        elif merge_strategy == MetricMergeStrategy.warn:
1286	            log.warning(
1287	                f"Attempting to log duplicate metric '{name}' for step {(self.global_step)}. "
1288	                "The latest value will be ignored."
1289	            )
1290	        elif merge_strategy == MetricMergeStrategy.oldest:
1291	            pass
1292	        else:
1293	            raise NotImplementedError(merge_strategy)
1294	
1295	        # reduce type must be consistent to avoid issues
1296	        if name in self._metrics_reduce_type and self._metrics_reduce_type[name] != reduce_type:
1297	            raise RuntimeError(
1298	                f"expected '{self._metrics_reduce_type[name]}' reduce type for metric '{name}' "
1299	                f"based on last record, but got '{reduce_type}' this time"
1300	            )
1301	        self._metrics_reduce_type[name] = reduce_type
1302	
1303	    def record_ce_loss(
1304	        self, value: Union[float, torch.Tensor], reduce_type: Optional[ReduceType] = None
1305	    ):
1306	        """
1307	        Record the cross-entropy loss metric specifically.
1308	        """
1309	        return self.record_metric(TRAIN_CE_LOSS_METRIC, value, reduce_type=reduce_type)

T = TypeVar("T")


def _metric_value_to_tensor(value: Union[float, torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor:
    if not isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
        # Coerce Python scalars to float64 so large integer metrics (e.g. token counts) don't
        # overflow or lose precision when torch would otherwise pick int64/float32.
        if isinstance(value, Real):
            return torch.tensor(value, dtype=torch.float64)
        return torch.tensor(value)

    return get_local_tensor(value.detach()).float()


class TrainerStateDict(TypedDict):
    global_step: int
    global_train_tokens_seen: int
    global_train_petaflops: float
    max_steps: Optional[int]
